matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN improves the COCO AP of Faster R-CNN by roughly two to four points across multiple backbones with negligible inference overhead.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN improves detection performance by about 4 points over the FPN+ baseline on COCO.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN trains a sequence of detectors with progressively higher IoU thresholds, where each stage's regressed boxes serve as proposals for the next.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN is a multi-stage object detection architecture consisting of a sequence of detectors trained with increasing IoU thresholds.

unmatched_a.a_claim_text_normalized: A single-IoU detector trained at a high threshold suffers from too few positive samples, while one trained at a low threshold produces noisy detections that limit final accuracy.
unmatched_a.comment: present in human gold A but not produced by independent extractor B

unmatched_b.b_claim_text_normalized: The resampling of progressively improved hypotheses in Cascade R-CNN guarantees that all detectors have a positive set of examples of equivalent size, reducing overfitting.
